auditor_value: (a) kinetic friction 4.8 N up the incline (g = 10 m/s²); (b) block slides down with a = 1.6 m/s²

findings.quote: The weight components along and perpendicular to the incline are already resolved: 12 N down the slope and 16 N into the slope.
findings.note: Nothing in the question as served resolves the weight; the 12 N and 16 N come from W = mg = 20 N with g = 10 m/s², a choice the solution never states. The line claims a given that does not exist instead of doing the resolution.
findings.fix: Take g = 10 m/s², so W = 20 N. Resolve the weight along and perpendicular to the incline: W sin37° = 20×0.6 = 12 N down the slope and W cos37° = 20×0.8 = 16 N into the slope.

notes: g is not fixed by the question; the solution silently uses g = 10 m/s² (with g = 9.8 the answers are 4.70 N and 1.53 m/s²). Both common-mistakes entries reproduce the numbers they name (3.6 and 5.6 m/s²).
